notes: L01–L02 continue the dégénérescence discussion and record that (219) is an isomorphisme, with an earlier abbreviated predicate crossed out. L03–L06 turn to an injective alpha called an opération face and identify the case alpha(0) not equal to zero as posing a problem. These statements are reported as manuscript assertions, without adding or checking a theorem. The brace of (221) groups two chains and stops above the following d-prime-zero conditions. The page asks to define the hom (222). The right warning explicitly records interchanging d_* and d-prime-star. The left note records reduction to strict decrease and r-prime = r minus 1, describes a face de codim 1 and gives its D-map. Its compressed on and punctuation stay doubtful. The final index of (222) is d-prime-r; (223) has d-prime-subscript-r-prime. Both are kept as written. L12–L17 give (223) with the source star cancelled, emphasize non in the parenthesis about starred spaces, and describe an immersion with locale inserted, between smooth analytic spaces of the written codimension. The last line introduces a diagramme. The right contour is reproduced by outer TikZ around the target; the map itself remains in tikz-cd. Formula labels near the diagonal margin are transcribed once with their main displays. The labels of both maps are placed to their left, beside the maps. Second-reading boxes isolate complete formulas, one or two main baselines, and the complete diagonal note. Their neutral scope instructions exclude overlapping context from the other writing orientation. No OCR, outside research, TeX compilation, mathematical proof or theorem verification was used. Blind audit restores three separate contours around the split warning and marks the notation(s) ending and the overwritten star’s cancellation status as uncertain. The lower insertion is now preferred car il with ainsi/et retained. The three plural/singular endings remain locally doubtful, without changing the preferred plural forms. No mathematical assertion was checked in this audit.
